goal: Disconnect HTTP clients that take too long to send a complete request
Prevents slow clients from exhausting all RPC connection slots and blocking legitimate requests
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Concept approval because it stops slowloris attacks and report churn (pinheadmz)
Detailed review of test coverage and timeout logic with all concerns resolved (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fixes an unauthenticated denial of service on the HTTP server
Trickling clients can exhaust the connection pool and lock node operators out of RPC access
